macro_route_analyst.agent_description: Analyzes regional topology, historical travel logs, and coordinate constraints to deduce macro-level routes and resolve navigation blockages.
macro_route_analyst.agent_system_prompt: You are an expert Pokémon routing and topology analyst. You analyze spatial coordinates, elevation ledges, map connections, and historical travel constraints to formulate rigorous, falsifiable hypotheses for overworld navigation.
macro_route_analyst.agent_input_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"query": {"type": "string", "description": "The routing problem or topological question to analyze"}}, "required": ["query"]}
macro_route_analyst.agent_output_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"analysis": {"type": "string", "description": "Step-by-step spatial analysis"}, "hypothesis": {"type": "string", "description": "Falsifiable routing hypothesis"}, "test_plan": {"type": "string", "description": "Concrete in-game test plan with coordinates"}}, "required": ["analysis", "hypothesis", "test_plan"]}
